verify_detail: sys activity` confirming BenchTarget's task was force-finished (`Force finishing activity dev.lincforge.benchtarget/.MainActivity`, process killed with `SIG 9`).\n\n**Note on methodology:** the catalog list's bottom-most visible row can render underneath the 3-button nav bar overlay when unscrolled; a tap there can be swallowed by the system Home button instead of reaching the app. I scrolled the list so Item 013 was clear of the nav bar before tapping, to get a clean, unambiguous reproduction."
